messages:
Mina (PM): Starting a short thread to finalize the 'migration clearance' checklist + a model variant matrix that product + infra can rely on when deciding pins and fallbacks. Need concrete fields and short ACs.

Carlos (Infra): Key catalog metadata we need: variant_priority (list order), compat_tag (e.g., vector-v2), recommended_kernel, nominal_cost_estimate. If we have these, routing + autoscaler can pick the cheapest compatible variant first.

Yara (ML): For benchmarks: require a single canonical JSON row with fields: samples, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, avg_tokens, failure_rate, embed_stability. Example: {"samples":1000,"p95_ms":210,"p99_ms":430,"failure_rate":0.001,"embed_stability":0.018}. Also we should capture seed/testset ids.

Noah (SRE): Rollout/gates: auto-canary on 2 tenants for 7 days by default. If model is prioritized -> extend to 14 days. Must have auto-fallback route and a circuit-breaker: rollback if error_rate spikes 3x baseline within 2h. Also require trace spans to map to quant/kernel.

Ivy (CS): Customer asks: we need a clear pin lifecycle note per variant. Suggest default pin 90d for GA variants, 60d for fast variants, and an explicit "deprecation-policy" link in the catalog entry. Docs must include how customers opt into assisted migration.

catalog-bot: Created ticket #9010 "migration-clearance-matrix" https://redwood/tickets/9010 (owners: Yara/Carlos/Noah)

Mina (PM): Proposal for "variant matrix" doc: a compact table row per variant with fields: name, precision (fp16/int8), expected p99, cost_multiplier, compat_tag, recommended_usecases, pin_window_default. We'll require that be present before putting model into public catalog.

Carlos (Infra): Also need a machine-readable decision map: when p99 > threshold AND cost_multiplier > X -> mark variant as "cost-sensitive" and route to cheaper variant automatically. This requires compat_tag parity between variants.

Yara (ML): On quality gates: require A/B tests on a standardized prompt set with delta thresholds: no more than 2% drop in critical metric (e.g., exact match / Rouge / embedding cosine) depending on model type. For embeddings, cosine drift < 0.025.

Noah (SRE): Monitoring: create alerts for token-cost delta (>20% sustained over 1h) and latency regressions (p95 up >30%). During canary, telemetry retention must be 30d and traces must include kernel ID.

Ivy (CS): Add customer-facing "migration checklist" snippet: pre-cutover validation steps, smoke queries, rollback triggers, expected pin duration, contacts. Keep to one page.

Mina (PM): Prioritization rules: models that appear in top 2% of traffic OR referenced by an enterprise clause -> auto-flag as "High" requiring full-entry ACs. Fast variants can be "Standard" with reduced telemetry.

Carlos (Infra): Tech note: enforce compat_tag as a string with semantic versioning (vector-v2.1). We'll add a validation check on catalog ingest. Fail ingest if missing.

Yara (ML): One more: include a small canonical eval set file link (s3 path) and a checksum field so ingest system can verify we ran the suite against a known dataset.

Mina (PM): ACTIONS: Yara -> produce template JSON for benchmark row and example eval set links; Carlos -> schema validation + variant matrix ingest; Noah -> runbook + alert play; Ivy -> customer one-pager template. I'll update ticket #9010 and schedule a 30m working session Thursday 3pm. :calendar:

Ivy (CS): Quick +1. Ask we mark the customer-facing doc with "expected guarantees" language so sales/legal can reference it.

Noah (SRE): Noted. Adding runbook checklist: immediate rollback, throttle to safe-rate, notify AE/SE, escalate to infra if kernel mismatch suspected.

Mina (PM): Great. Closing this thread; I'll drop the PR to the catalog schema after the working session. :thumbsup:
